title: The Structural Theorem of Capitalism: Minimal Permission Support, Public Functional Replay, and Unique Minimal Risk Pricing

additional_titles.title: 资本主义的结构总定理：全形态最小支撑、公共功能重放与唯一最小风险定价

description: Across industrial wage labor, care outsourcing, financial credit, platform algorithms, automated factories, and state-managed enterprise, what minimal institutional structure makes a production relation capitalist, and does coordinating production or pricing unknown innovation risk require permanent private residual control? Proved and machine-checked in Lean 4 over universal laws, constructor types, execution words, and institutional histories, this Second Edition establishes the Structural Theorem of Capitalism across six load-bearing pillars (CF0–CF17, Theorems 1–19). First, complete exclusion of capital across five faces—private access discrepancy, capital relation kernel, proper transferable title, surplus appropriation, and active reproduction of historical claims—holds if and only if permission rules contain no asymmetric access gate where a controller is admitted while a dependent user is refused; every actual capital witness compiles from real production, need, return, and control data and enters one social termination-and-continuation contract. Second, for every finite production word, a source-generated public functional replay of identical length preserves the exact successor state, physical item mapping, universal living and maintenance provision, and task service adequacy while clearing controller consent gates and capital kernels to zero. Third, from any actual cut, disposition terminates within current internal workload plus one step in either a complete abolition witness—jointly certifying independent execution, full needs provision, productive capacity, zero new control, executable futures, and full-account Pareto non-loss with a strict gain—or an exact financial, migration, or future-feasibility residual. Fourth, mechanisms fixed prior to unknown events support two-round off-menu innovation and bound cumulative receipts across all account slots of any contribution origin by its issued quantity. Fifth, without subjective probability priors, utility functions, or exogenous discount rates, executable outside baselines (a_P, a_B) and complete branch incomes (y_P, y_B) on each paid local-signal fiber endogenously determine the bilateral safe interval max(a_P - y_P) <= q <= min(y_B - a_B), whose rational point closest to zero is the unique minimal necessary risk transfer q*, settled with zero hidden claim residual while strictly separating surplus distribution, shortfall, and overcharge (CF17). Sixth, complete ledgers separate resource-sufficient optimal financial tails from complete-clearance domains with strictly cheaper rooted continuations (3 + 1/(n+2)), transport all prior claims injectively across finite institutional histories, and pinpoint any resurgent capital witness to an active permission discrepancy.

additional_descriptions.description: 无论采取工业雇佣、照护外包、金融信贷、平台算法、自动化工厂还是国家资本等何种历史形态，使生产关系成为资本关系的最小制度结构究竟是什么？协调社会化生产与为未知创新风险定价是否必然要求授予私人永久剩余控制权？本文第二版（v2）在 Lean 4 形式化证明支撑下给出覆盖全部法则、构造类型、执行序列与制度历史的资本主义结构总定理（CF0–CF17，定理 1–19）。第一，五面完整无资本条件（无私人准入差异、无资本关系核心、无排他可转让头衔、无剩余占有、无历史关系的当期再生产）成立当且仅当生产准入端口不存在控制者获准而依赖使用者被拒的权限不对称；一切实际资本见证均由真实生产、需要、回流与控制证据唯一重构，并自行生成正登记进入统一社会终止与续行合同。第二，任意有限生产执行词均具有同长度源生公共功能重放，在严格保持完整后态、全部物量映射、全员生活维护实付与任务服务适足性的同时将控制者同意门与资本核清零。第三，从实际运行的任意截点出发，在当前内部工作量加一步内必达完整废止见证（共同保住独立执行、全员生活维护、生产能力、零新控制、可执行未来及逐人逐物量全账不损与严格增益）或精确财务／迁移／未来阻塞残差。第四，未知事件前固定的试验机制支持菜单外连续两轮实付技术创新，且同一贡献发行来源在全部账户槽位的累计实际受偿严格受原发行数量封顶。第五，无需预设主观概率先验、外生效用函数或贴现率，由双方零参数可执行外部替代基准 (a_P, a_B) 与同付费局部信号纤维上各报价分支的完整账户收入 (y_P, y_B) 内生导出双边安全闭区间 max(a_P - y_P) <= q <= min(y_B - a_B)，其中离零最近的有理数 q* 即为唯一最小必要风险补偿，以两阶段签发与实付结算实现零隐蔽残余头寸，并将合法超额分配、提供方欠付和付款方超付严格四分（CF17）。第六，完整账户区分资源足额财务尾段的实际最优达到者与完整清算域的严格下降后继族（3 + 1/(n+2)），沿任意有限制度演进单射保全全部旧债权与物量来源，并将任何资本再生见证精确定位到活动权限分歧地址。
